title: HPF AI Disclosure Schema
description: JSON Schema for HPF AI Disclosure metadata. Pre-v1 draft, not a final v1.0 commitment. hpf_standard_version and hpf_classification are required when an HPF record is present. From 0.9.3 hpf_released_version is also required, identifying the released version the declaration covers; records naming 0.9.2 or earlier do not require it, the schema permits it on them, and they remain valid under the version they name. The version field was named hpf_taxonomy_version before 0.9.2; a record using the old name is a record made under the earlier draft, is validated against the schema published with that draft, and is kept as received. hpf_descriptors is optional and, from 0.9.4, specified for implementation: an array of one or more distinct controlled values, restricted by classification (none on no_ai, altered_performance only on assistive_ai, any on generative_ai). The values and restrictions are unchanged since 0.9.2, so a record made under 0.9.2 or 0.9.3 that carries descriptors stays valid. The schema does not reject descriptors on a record naming 0.9, 0.9.0 or 0.9.1. Those versions define no descriptors, so values on such a record have no HPF meaning and are not read with a later version's definitions. Descriptor meanings are defined by the version named in hpf_standard_version, so a stable value has a stable meaning for a given version. Where no HPF declaration exists, omit the record entirely rather than writing null field values. Published by Human Provenance in Film under CC BY 4.0.

hpf_standard_version.description: The version of the HPF AI Disclosure Standard applied to this record.

hpf_released_version.description: The released version of the work that the declaration covers, as the declaration names it. A released version is a separately released editorial edition or substantive localisation of a work, identified by its picture, sound and, where relevant, embedded audience-facing text. Required from 0.9.3. HPF prescribes no identifier scheme.

hpf_classification.description: The HPF disclosure category for the released version the declaration covers. Derived from a signed producer declaration.

hpf_descriptors.description: OPTIONAL. The descriptors the declaring party recorded for the released version, defined in the Descriptors section of the version named in hpf_standard_version. Adopted in 0.9.4; the values are unchanged from 0.9.2. Each value records a distinct kind of AI output present: altered_performance, AI changed a captured or recorded performance by an identifiable person; digital_replica, AI generated a representation of an identifiable person; synthetic_performance, AI generated performance content that does not represent an identifiable person; generated_voice, AI generated spoken or vocal content; generated_visual_content, AI generated visual content; generated_writing, AI generated written content embodied in the released version; generated_music, AI generated music. Descriptors never determine or change the classification and carry no threshold. altered_performance may appear on an assistive_ai or a generative_ai record; every other value applies to generative_ai only; no descriptor applies to no_ai. Order carries no meaning. Values may not repeat. Where no descriptor is declared, omit the field: an empty array is invalid. An omitted field means none was declared, not that none applies.
